headline: Approved a one-year agreement for an MHOA grant-funded tobacco inspector and the August meeting minutes.

plain_text:
SPECIAL WORCESTER BOARD OF HEALTH MEETING 
Meeting Minutes 
September 18, 2026 @ 10:30am 
25 MEADE STREET, ROOM 109 1ST FLOOR. WORCESTER, MA 
 
 
 
Welcome 
Board members present: 
Joseph Kahoro 
Patrick Lowe 
Frances Anthes 
 
Board members absent 
Michael Perotto 
 
Staff present  
Nikki Nixon, DPH Director  
Jennifer Nakijoba, Chief of Community Health, DPH 
Desiree Sutton, Business Manager, DPH  
Brenda Wright, Principal Clerk, DPH  
 
1. Call to Order 
Chair Frances Anthes called the Special Meeting of the Worcester Board of Health to order at 
10:30am 
2. Welcome and Introductions 
Chair Frances Anthes welcomed everyone and made special mention of Nikki Nixon.  
The Board welcomed Nikki as the new Director of Public Health. Chair Frances noted that she has 
served in the interim role for approximately six months and has done a great job learning the 
position and preparing to move the Division’s work forward. The Board congratulated her and 
expressed its appreciation for her work done and welcomed the opportunity to work with her in 
her new role. 
 
3. Announcements 
The Chair reported that the September Board of Health meeting, which was scheduled to be held 
fully virtually, experienced technical difficulties that prevented some participants from accessing 
the meeting. To ensure compliance with the Open Meeting Law (OML) and provide appropriate 
public access, the meeting was rescheduled to September 30, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. The Chair noted 
that the September 30 meeting will be held in person.
A Special Board of Health meeting was convened to address a time -sensitive matter that needed 
to be completed prior to the rescheduled September 30 meeting. The Special Meeting therefore 
included a brief agenda focused solely on that matter. 
 
4. Minutes of last meeting 
The Chair called for a motion to approve the minutes of August BOH meeting presented. 
 
Motion made by: Patrick Lowe. It passed unanimously with Joseph Kahoro, Patrick Lowe and 
Frances Anthes voting yes.  
 
5. Tobacco Inspector Appointment / MHOA Grant 
 
Nikki Nixon, DPH Director provided an overview of the Massachusetts Municipal Health Officials 
Association (MHOA) grant, which provides resources to increase the Division of Public Health’s 
tobacco enforcement capacity. 
 
Through a mutual agreement, the Division will engage a tobacco inspector for one year. The 
additional capacity will strengthen tobacco compliance and enforcement efforts while allowing 
Tobacco Prevention Specialist Kyle O’Connor, to focus more on education, outreach, and building 
relationships with tobacco retailers. 
 
Board members expressed support for the partnership and the additional enforcement capacity. 
They noted the importance of maintaining inspections while also providing education and building 
relationships with tobacco retailers. 
 
The Chair called for a motion to approve the appointment of an MHOA Tobacco Inspector for 
one year who will work with the Division of Public Health. 
 
Motion: To approve the agreement for the tobacco inspector appointment. 
Motion made by: Patrick Lowe 
Vote: 
Patrick Lowe – Yes 
Joseph Kahoro – Yes 
Frances Anthes – Yes 
Motion passed unanimously. 
 
Board discussions 
Chair Anthes reviewed upcoming Board business and noted that the next full Board of Health 
meeting will be held on September 30, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. She stated that the meeting will include 
the agenda items from the previously scheduled meeting that were not addressed due to technical 
difficulties. 
 
Homelessness 
The Chair discussed adding an item regarding ‘homelessness’ to the September 30 agenda, given 
increased discussions of the issue within the City. She noted that it has been an ongoing issue and
has recently become a topic of discussion at City Council.  The Board requested an update from 
staff at the next BOH meeting on the City's homelessness efforts.  
 
New Tobacco Regulations 
Staff reported that there are several requests from tobacco retailers for hearings. The Board agreed 
to provide an opportunity for them to address these matters. September 30 and October 19 were 
suggested as potential meeting dates.  
 
6. Adjournment 
 
A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Joseph Kahoro. All voted in favor. 
 
The meeting adjourned at 10:45am.
